Mental health matters. This #MentalHealthAwarenessMonth, take a moment to prioritize your mental health and recommit to integrating physical and mental health. I was proud to spearhead the largest investment in community-based mental health care in American history, and as founder and co-chair of the Bipartisan Senate Mental Health Caucus, I will continue fighting to improve care, reduce stigma, and increase access to resources.

As a former caregiver to my grandmother with Alzheimer’s, I know firsthand the importance of brain health & the devastating impacts Alzheimer’s can have on our loved ones. This Alzheimer’s & Brain Awareness Month, I’m proud to help spread awareness about brain health & support those living with it and their caregivers.

As the founder and co-chair of the bipartisan Senate Mental Health Caucus, I remain committed to efforts to make resources available for Americans who struggle with mental health crises.

September is #SuicidePrevention Month, a time to raise awareness of mental health and offer support to those in need. As co-chair of the Bipartisan Senate Mental Health Caucus, I am proud to partner with organizations like the @988Lifeline to support Americans struggling with mental health crises, reduce the stigma, and save lives.
